entities.summary: Song Young-moo (b. 1949-02-24, Nonsan) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nonsan and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, military leaders & commanders, asia.
